name: CI

on:
  push:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'guides/**'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'guides/**'

jobs:
  ci:
    env:
      MIX_ENV: test

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - pair:
              elixir: '1.15'
              otp: '25.3'
              mysql: '8.4'
              postgres: '14.22-alpine'
          - pair:
              elixir: '1.20'
              otp: '29.0'
              mysql: '9.1'
              postgres: '18.4-alpine'
            lint: lint

    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:${{matrix.pair.postgres}}
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: oban_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432/tcp
      mysql:
        image: mysql:${{matrix.pair.mysql}}
        env:
          MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD: "yes"
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "mysqladmin ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 3306/tcp

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@v1
        with:
          otp-version: ${{matrix.pair.otp}}
          elixir-version: ${{matrix.pair.elixir}}

      - uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: |
            deps
            _build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-mix-${{matrix.pair.elixir}}-${{matrix.pair.otp}}-${{ hashFiles('**/mix.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-mix-${{matrix.pair.elixir}}-${{matrix.pair.otp}}-

      - name: Seed fake assets
        run: mkdir -p priv/static && touch priv/static/app.css && touch priv/static/app.js

      - name: Unlock optional dependencies
        run: mix deps.unlock oban_pro

      - name: Run mix deps.get
        run: mix deps.get

      - name: Run mix format
        run: mix format --check-formatted
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - name: Run mix deps.unlock
        run: mix deps.unlock --check-unused
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - name: Run mix deps.compile
        run: mix deps.compile

      - name: Run mix compile
        run: mix compile --warnings-as-errors
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - name: Run credo
        run: mix credo --strict
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - name: Run mix ecto.migrate
        env:
          MYSQL_URL: mysql://root@localhost:${{job.services.mysql.ports[3306]}}/oban_test
          POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:${{job.services.postgres.ports[5432]}}/oban_test
        run: mix test.setup

      - name: Run mix test
        env:
          MYSQL_URL: mysql://root@localhost:${{job.services.mysql.ports[3306]}}/oban_test
          POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:${{job.services.postgres.ports[5432]}}/oban_test
        run: mix test

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
